newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MCI cut to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MCI cut to hold from buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday it had cut its rating for MCI Communications Corp to hold from buy because of the proposed merger with British Telecommunications Plc.

-- "This transaction, which could net MCI shareholders between $35 and $36 a share when the deal is ultimately consummated (or more depending on BT's price), is a welcome event for the holders of MCI who have continually struggled over the lack of value placed upon MCI's core business as well as numerous strategic endeavors," analyst Stuart Conrad wrote in a report.
-- "... However, we also believe that investors must be wondering why the company sold out so low."

-- He added, "With this move by MCI, it appears that the internal outlook may actually not be as strong as we, or the company, have projected. ... We also are lowering EPS estimate to $1.90 from our previous $2 projection."
